items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: I did nothing but shirts for Mr. Villere and all them people, shirts only.

ctx.x: You told me last year that sometime you sing to yourself when you're working around the house to keep from being lonesome.

When I was young, that's all I passed my time in. And work hard, hard, hard. I did nothing but shirts for Mr. Villere and all them people, shirts only. And I'd have the yard lined with shirts. All day the lady next door, they sewed, and they used to put their machine by the window to hear me sing. Uh-huh. And all day long, and one day one of the ladies says, but at least I always hear you say, oh, I'm hungry. I never hear you sound tired. I say, well, I'm never tired. Sing, sing, sing, sing, sing, sing all day.
That kept you from getting tired?
